checks: The log card offers a filter, descending time order and an empty disabled reset
Newest-first sorting uses the full date across midnight and stable IDs for equal timestamps
Filtering is case-insensitive and displays the matching and total counts
Live messages respect the active filter without replacing existing rows or the focused input
The time button switches to oldest-first order and remembers the choice on this device
A newly received older timestamp is inserted at its chronological position
Clearing the filter and reversing the sort restores all rows with their existing DOM nodes
An unmatched filter explains the empty result while keeping reset available
Reset clears all local messages including filtered-out entries
New messages appear after reset without restoring earlier messages
Moving and resizing the card keeps the controls, messages and game rows intact
Hidden log cards continue receiving entries without becoming visible
Remount restores history and filter with one active log subscription
A live message after remount appears exactly once
Log messages and filtering treat markup as text
The filter and buttons remain inside the card at mobile width
Reload retains the selected time sort and starts a fresh browser log history
Log controls produce no browser exceptions
